name: Cutover Runbook - A Tick That Could Not Be Saved

cutoverDecisions.answer: Nadia has the GoDaddy login and will make the record edits herself with Jared on a call.
Split it — the example sponsors come down before cutover; the rest can be fixed live.

description: A tick that could not be saved, shown where a reader would actually meet it rather than in isolation. The preview holds a signed-in session but no GitHub token, so the commit is genuinely refused — this is the real failure path, not a mocked likeness of it. What matters is that the box goes BACK: the tick shows optimistically, the commit fails, and the step returns to not-started with the reason beside it. On a page whose whole claim is that what it shows is what everyone else sees, a tick that stayed ticked locally would be a lie the next reader has no way to detect, and worse than having no checkbox at all.
